summary: Frontend-only validation of the anexos cache-warming + Object Storage fallback fix. Logged in as admin (rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve), navigated to Gestión Comercial > Cotizaciones, opened AnexosModal from the quotes grid, and validated PDF download end-to-end from the UI. Additionally located the exact quote referenced in the request (COT-2026-04-076-PYME → quote_id quo_34d3d4705085) and downloaded its attachment via the same authenticated fetch used by AnexosModal.handleDownload. Both downloads returned HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, valid PDF magic header (%PDF), non-zero payload, and completed in <300ms — no timeouts, no 404s, no console/network errors related to the flow.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings <tr> child of <span> and <span> child of <tbody> from the dynamic-render wrapper (data-ve-dynamic span in Dashboard.jsx:389 and QuotesTable.jsx:289). Unrelated to anexos fix — already noted in iteration_303.

critical_code_review_comments: AnexosModal.jsx:108-135 handleDownload correctly uses fetch + Bearer token, verifies response.ok, opens PDF in new tab via blob URL, and cleans up with URL.revokeObjectURL after 30s — clean pattern.

Backend endpoint GET /api/quotes/{quote_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}/download responded instantly (44ms for a 106KB PDF, 257ms for a 1.1MB PDF) which is consistent with the cache-warming path serving from local FS after the backfill. No indication of Object Storage cold-fetch latency during this run.
No stray 4xx/5xx on /api/* observed during the flow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 attachment downloads verified: COT-2026-07-032-CORP 1.1MB PDF, COT-2026-04-076-PYME 106KB PDF; both HTTP 200 + application/pdf + %PDF magic)

seed_data_creation: None. Only GET/download operations, no state mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified attachments download flow via AnexosModal for both a random quote (quo_b58433f8c523 / COT-2026-07-032-CORP) and the specific quote requested (quo_34d3d4705085 / COT-2026-04-076-PYME / attachment att_e07885deeb74).
